So, in this video, I'm going to show you the three mistakes almost 98% of beginners make when they're learning AWS, and then I'll reveal the critical shift that will fix all three of those mistakes at once. Now, this is one of many strategies that my students are using inside of my academy that's giving them an unfair advantage in the job market today. And literally, in the last 2 weeks, over five of my students have landed new cloud roles. So, make of that what you will. Let's get into it. Now, mistake number one is trying to learn all 280 services at once. So, this is what usually happens. You open the AWS console, or you just do some research for the first time, and there is 200 services staring back at you. So, you make a very reasonable assumption. You decide that the more services and tools that you know, the more employable that you become. Therefore, you start taking off one service at a time. EC2, Lambda, ECS, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS.
